II. Fungi are less diverse than mammals
III. Over 70% of recorded species are animals
IV. Fungi have more species than fishes, amphibians, reptiles and mammals combined
why: Correct statements: III, IV.

subject: Biology
q:
Assertion (A): Fungi have more species than fishes, amphibians, reptiles and mammals combined.
Reason (R): Plants make up over 70% of recorded species.
opts: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
why: A is true; R is false.
